_comment: The stream each bundle class name routes to. Shared by colca (Go) and by
every Python consumer that has to know where a contract's records land,
so the mapping is stated once instead of re-implemented per language.
colca's StreamFor is the authority; plugins/uns/manifest_streams_test.go
pins this file against it in BOTH directions, so a class added to Go with
no entry here fails, and an entry here that Go does not route fails too.
An empty string means the class has no stream at all: nothing persists it.
